comments.author: Hernan
comments.body:
I'll try to list 3 options for that
note: max sail limit for clipper is 90/90, and if you aim to max speed you might want to make it -19% cargo
also i recommend to add high lookout as original ship skill (optional, would cost around 5-15m for parts + 200PA)

A. Clipper + EA
1) large gaff sail + antifouling paint + admiral cabins
2) large gaff sail + large mast + admiral cabins
3) large square sail + large mast + admiral cabins
normal results would be: 105/90 sail +6TS +3WR -1armor

B. Clipper + EA + Wind resistant mast
1) large gaff sail + antifouling paint + admiral cabins
2) large gaff sail + large mast + set of repair tools
3) large square sail + large mast + admiral cabins
normal results would be: 110/90 sail +4TS +2WR -1armor

C. Clipper + EA + Adjutant Cabin
1) large gaff sail + antifouling paint + admiral cabins
2) large gaff sail + aide's cabin + set of repair tools
3) large square sail + large mast + large mast
normal results would be: 105/90 sail +4TS +1WR

for all parts needed each option would cost roughly 30-50m if you buy them in seville coshop

comments.body: I am wondering this as well. Or if I will have to wait for level 67 trade and 53 adventure for a Tea Clipper.:)

comments.author: Spy.
comments.body:
Its hard to answer that because there's so many factors to think about first, but in my opinion Clipper can beat LMS. Afterall, LMS is a trade ship & adv ship is always faster. If you're adventurer, just try to carry less than 50 (20 for me lol) supplies per trip which makes it faster & when going full adventure, just let your aide ship go, they will take some food which will require more cargo. Afterall, every seconds count when you're trying to beat a LMS.
So basically Clipper can beat LMS as long as the captain of Clipper is wise enough to set it to full speed status ;)

comments.author: Spy.
comments.body:
My advice really is to use a ship you prefer, like if you think trade ship is better than adv ship then do so. Try not to follow other people --I suppose like me lol-- and play your own style, its boring to follow the mainstream, do it the other way! :)
Its a game afterall, don't get too serious on it, play at your own rules, time, etc.
Be an adventurer, sail around, discover stuff.
Be a trader, trade & get to know all the region specialties and production knowledge.
Be a maritimer & talk all day.. kidding x) and pew pew some stuff, but don't let other people change your gameplay just cause its the best way blah blah.
Meh.. just my 2 cent
